## Standards

<a id="CommonMark"></a>

### CommonMark

`CommonMark` · `src/markdown.ts:19`

The Markdown syntax of the documents that Trame writes. The marks that several constructs share are here.

Source: CommonMark Spec 0.31.2 (2024) · `https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `endOfLine` | `"\n"` | Ends a line (§ 2.1: a line feed, U+000A) |
| `space` | `" "` | Separates a mark from what it introduces (§ 2.1: U+0020) |
| `backtick` | `` ` `` | Delimits code, inline or in a block (§ 4.5, § 6.1) |
| `asterisk` | `*` | Delimits emphasis (§ 6.2) |

- Maintained by: trame
- Defines: [Backtick string](#BacktickString), [Blank line](#BlankLine), [Block quote](#BlockQuote), [Sequence of blocks](#Blocks), [Code block](#CodeBlock), [Code span](#CodeSpan), [Emphasis](#Emphasis), [Heading](#Heading), [Link](#Link), [List item](#ListItem), [Strong emphasis](#StrongEmphasis)
- Used by: [Backtick string](#BacktickString), [Blank line](#BlankLine), [Block quote](#BlockQuote), [Sequence of blocks](#Blocks), [Code block](#CodeBlock), [Code span](#CodeSpan), [Emphasis](#Emphasis), [Heading](#Heading), [Link](#Link), [List item](#ListItem), [Strong emphasis](#StrongEmphasis), [Table cell](#TableCell), [Table row](#TableRow)

<a id="BlankLine"></a>

### Blank line

`BlankLine` · `src/markdown.ts:51` · status: **held**

A line with no characters. It closes a block: what follows starts another one (a paragraph, a list, an HTML block). Each block is closed by one; a block left out closes nothing.

Section: 4.9 Blank lines · `https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#blank-lines`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `blank` | `""` | A line containing no characters (refines Texts.empty) |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `[["# Title"],["Text","More text"]]` | `["# Title","","Text","More text",""]` | held |
| `[["a"],false,["b"]]` | `["a","","b",""]` | held |

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `standard` ← [CommonMark](#CommonMark)
- Body: inline, in the declaration
- Defined by: [CommonMark](#CommonMark)
- Refines: [Texts](../std/releases/0.17.0/docs/algebra.md#Texts)
- Used by: [Sequence of blocks](#Blocks), [Collapsible block](#Details)

<a id="RelativeReference"></a>

### Relative reference

`RelativeReference` · `src/markdown.ts:289` · status: **held**

The address of a file from the documents, followed by an anchor; or the anchor alone, in the document itself. A path is given from the project's root: a document reaches another in the same folder by its name, and any other file of the project (the documents of a library) by going up to the root first.

Section: 4.2 Relative reference; 3.5 Fragment; 5.2.4 Remove dot segments · `https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986#section-4.2`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `segment` | `/` | Separates the segments of a path |
| `fragment` | `#` | Introduces the fragment: the anchor, in the target document |
| `parent` | `..` | The segment that goes up one level: from the documents to the project's root |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `"docs/product.md", "Goal"` | `"product.md#Goal"` | held |
| `undefined, "Graph"` | `"#Graph"` | held |
| `"docs/product.md"` | `"product.md"` | held |
| `"std/docs/algebra.md", "Counts"` | `"../std/docs/algebra.md#Counts"` | held |
| `"../std/docs/index.md"` | `"../../std/docs/index.md"` | held |
